newsitem.title: USA: International Lottery CEO purchases stock.
newsitem.headline: International Lottery CEO purchases stock.

text.p: International Lottery Inc Thursday said its chairman and chief executive L. Rogers Wells had acquired 70,000 shares of the company's stock at $8.00 per share.

Wells, in a press release, also said the company's leasing program strategy assures it strong cash flow and earnings growth over the foreseeable future. He said security analysts estimate that adjusted earnings per share in 1997 will be $2.40, compared to $1.58 in 1996.
International Lottery designs, manufactures, sells, leases and services dispensing machines for the lottery, telecommunications and financial services industries.
